name: Danganronpa: Hope's End
source:
After the death of Junko Enoshima, worshippers of Junko start their own killing games, as to make Junko proud.

Follow Hamari Yui and her classmates as they're forced into a killing game to fight for their lives.

[From [url=https://catstercatster.itch.io/danganronpa-hopes-end]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
江之岛纯子死后，纯子的崇拜者们开始了自己的杀戮游戏，以让纯子感到自豪。

跟随Hamari Yui和她的同学，他们被迫进入一场为生存而战的杀戮游戏。

[来自[url=https://catstercatster.itch.io/danganronpa-hopes-end]itch.io[/url]]
